newsitem.title: UK: Madonna says baby daughter must read Bible.
newsitem.headline: Madonna says baby daughter must read Bible.

text.p: Raunchy pop superstar Madonna says her baby daughter Lourdes will not be allowed to watch television and will have to read the Bible as she grows up.
But the star of the hit film musical Evita has no plans to marry the child's father, Carlos Leon.

Madonna, once renowned for flaunting her sexuality in steamy videos and "soft porn" photos, told She Magazine: "People are extremely judgmental of me and my choice to have a child and not be married, as if I were the first person to do it.
"For some reason I'm being held up as some anti-family symbol. I know lots of married people who have terribly unhealthy relationships -- marriage isn't a guarantee of anything."
The 38-year-old singer condemned lazy parents who sat their children in front of the television for hours.

"TV's poison. To be plopped in front of a TV instead of being read to, talked to or encouraged to interact with other human beings is a huge mistake and that's what happens to a lot of children." she said.
Madonna also pledged that Lourdes would be brought up as a Christian.

The singer, whose marriage to actor Sean Penn failed, said: "She'll certainly know about Catholicism. I want my daughter to read the Bible, but I will explain to her that these are stories that people made up to teach people -- it's not the rule."
